author_reference.author: Aswath Damodaran
author_reference.title: Ups and Downs: Valuing Cyclical and Commodity Companies
author_reference.support: Average scaled profit margins and apply to recent revenues; Toyota's annual example is consistent with equal margin weights.

calculation.project_adaptation: Strict metadata/period checks, explicit equal declared-annual weights, isolated Decimal arithmetic and unresolved adoption are local API rules; the author did not prescribe a universal period weighting or automatic full-cycle test.

limitations: Matching caller metadata and carrying source/quote references do not verify the documents, annual declarations, period comparability, full-cycle coverage or applicability today; 52/53-week and changed fiscal years need separate review.
Unknown bounds and unlisted/missing years are not inferred or filled; known overlaps are rejected, but unknown dates cannot prove a complete or nonoverlapping history.
Signed income is retained; no loss row is removed or clamped, no displayed margin is substituted, and no sales/period weighting, annualization or currency/unit conversion is performed.

The applied amount is an arithmetic candidate, not reported profit or an adopted normalized forecast; no return on capital, reinvestment, financing, valuation, price, IR action or forecast probability is calculated.
